---
title: "leaflet.indoor R Markdown example"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.indoor)

leaflet(
  indoor_demo,
  options = leafletOptions(crs = leafletCRS("L.CRS.Simple"))
) |>
  addIndoor(
    label = ~name,
    popup = ~description,
    style = list(fillColor = ~fill),
    crs = "simple"
  ) |>
  addIndoorControl(position = "bottomright")
```
